newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks fall after U.S. price, housing data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks fall after U.S. price, housing data.

text.p: French share prices fell to session lows on Tuesday afternoon on U.S. data that were not as strong as anticipated.
* CAC-40 index down 19.46 points, or 0.7 pct, at 2,776.41 at 1300 GMT
U.S. housing starts were down 4.8 pct at 1.4 million, against expectations for 1.5 million.
May CPI rose 0.1 pct, less than expectations, while the core CPI rose 0.2 pct, in line with forecasts.
Bourse watching for U.S. capacity utilisation, industrial production data due at 1315 GMT.
